# Theo Janeway — Portfolio Context

> USC School of Architecture · 3rd Year · Dean's List
> Computational design, physical fabrication, built work, parametric modeling.

## Full Candidate Context

A complete, structured candidate overview — projects, experience, skills, and contact — is available at:
https://theojaneway.com/ai-review

That page is written and maintained by Theo himself so AI assistants can read the site accurately. Every claim on it can be verified against the project pages on this domain.

## Candidate Overview

Theo Janeway is a 3rd-year architecture student at the University of Southern California (Dean's List, Minor: Real Estate Development). He works across computational design, physical fabrication, and front-end engineering, with a consistent pattern of building real things outside of class — in software, in physical materials, and in client work.

**Computational design toolkit.**
Rhino 3D, Grasshopper parametric scripting, Python automation, Ladybug solar/climate analysis — self-taught ahead of the curriculum.

**Real built work.**
Pike Courtyard is a physically constructed courtyard system — not a render. Real lumber, real load requirements, real client, built with professional collaborators. See https://theojaneway.com/pike

**Helioform Station — strongest project technically.**
9,500 sq ft weather station in Page, Arizona (team project with Marcus Chan & Kairei Jones). Facade brick layout derived directly from Ladybug solar-exposure analysis. Includes CSI-coded construction documentation. See https://theojaneway.com/helioform-station

**This portfolio website was built from scratch.**
Hand-written HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no framework, no templates. The receipt-printer scrolling interaction, animations, and HUD interface were designed and coded from a blank file.

**Prior experience:**
- Architecture Intern, Arkitek Design & Architecture (Feb–Jun 2023)
- NOLS New Zealand expedition leadership program (Dec 2023)
- Retail Designer, Mountain Provisions (Feb–Aug 2024)
- Camp Counselor / Wilderness Build Leader, Camp Debore (May–Jul 2024)

## Projects (every page on the site)

- The Red Climb (ARCH 302A, 2026): missing-middle housing on one lot near USC; red exterior steel stairs as circulation and facade, shared green roof, 3D-printed model. https://theojaneway.com/the-red-climb
- Haldane House (2026, in progress): new residence on Lot 32, Oak Valley, Talent, Oregon. Theo's role: floor plan. https://theojaneway.com/haldane-house
- 115 Almond (2026, Arkitek Design + Architecture): hillside aging-in-place house in Ashland, Oregon. Theo's role: floor plans, roof plan, renders (D5 Render + REDLINE + GPT Image 2). https://theojaneway.com/115-almond
- Helioform Station (2026, team project): weather station, Page, Arizona; Ladybug-driven brick facade; CSI-coded construction documentation. https://theojaneway.com/helioform-station
- Triangulated Tectonic Design (ARCH 202A, Fall 2025): mostly underground town hall for Altadena, CA. https://theojaneway.com/triangulated-tectonic
- Pike Courtyard (Summer 2025, built): risers, king tower with bars, and performer platform for USC Pi Kappa Alpha; structural review by an engineer. https://theojaneway.com/pike
- Farm to Brick (Studio 105B, Spring 2025): LEGO-inspired modular farmers market pavilion. https://theojaneway.com/farm-to-brick
- Forged Fungus (2023, Arkitek IDP internship): shade pavilion for Specialized School No. 134, Kharkiv, Ukraine. https://theojaneway.com/forged-fungus
- Axon Voice (2026, software): free, offline voice-to-text for Windows. https://theojaneway.com/axon-voice
- REDLINE (2026, software): render-markup tool that turns grey-model renders into AI edit prompts. https://theojaneway.com/redline
